about_the_game:
Obelus Manor is a horror first person dungeon crawler set in an ever-changing haunted house.

At the top of a lonely forested hill rests what remains of the Obelus Manor. The locals know it to be an abandoned monument to past tragedies, but rumor has it that the manor is home to a plethora of spirits and other supernatural phenomenon.

Three explorers find themselves drawn to the house for different reasons, but each find that the forces within do not want them to leave. The player will need to navigate a sprawling labyrinth, survive encounters with the paranormal, complete personal quests and find a way out of the manor before they lose their mind.

Features:

  • Old-school first person dungeon crawling

  • 3 player classes and a wide cast of weird and wacky characters to meet or recruit

  • Grueling paranormal encounters with options to attack, run or hide

  • Unsettling hand drawn visuals

  • Atmospheric soundtrack and eerie ambient soundscapes

  • Roguelike elements; Obelus Manor changes in both major and subtle ways every time a new person enters

  • Multiple endings
